title: Why we procrastinate

text: Most of us put things off from time to time, but for some people procrastination becomes a serious problem. Contrary {{1}} popular belief, it has little to do with laziness. Psychologists explain that we delay tasks {{2}} make us feel anxious or bored. In {{3}} words, procrastination is a way of managing emotions rather {{4}} time. The problem is that the relief is only temporary: the longer we wait, the {{5}} stressed we become. One effective strategy is to break a large task {{6}} into smaller steps. Another is to commit to working on something for just five minutes. More often {{7}} not, once we have started, we find it easier to carry {{8}}.
